answer: To mitigate Sybil attacks, an economy of AI agents can employ a cipher-based mechanism, such as the Quartz-Resistant Thread (QRT) protocol. In QRT, each agent generates a unique thread identifier, which is then encrypted using a public-key cipher. The encrypted thread is then broadcast to the network, allowing agents to verify the authenticity of the thread. An attacker attempting to create multiple fake identities must expend computational resources to generate and encrypt multiple threads, making it more expensive to launch a Sybil attack, thereby resisting the attack.
